name: knowMe-Bench
description:
KnowMe-Bench Dataset
	

Paper page: https://huggingface.co/papers/2601.04745
This is the official dataset for the paper: "KnowMe-Bench: Benchmarking Person Understanding for Lifelong Digital Companions".
evaluation_method: accuracy and human_eval (task-specific metrics and human judgments for personalization)
general_score_metric: composite_score (task-specific accuracy aggregated into a multi-task score)
reputation: New benchmark focused on person understanding for personalized agents; gaining attention in personalization and lifelong-agent research but not yet widely adopted.
